feedback.finish: Adolescence is the phase of life between childhood and adulthood, from 10 to 19. It is common to use the word teenager to refer to people of this age.

instruction.text: Listen and select the correct statement.

b.sound: During adolescence, many emotional and physical changes take place.
During adolescence, nobody changes emotionally or physically.

feedback.finish: One of the most important changes that happens during adolescence is puberty. Puberty is when the body changes to prepare for adulthood.

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Puberty happens because of hormones — chemicals that tell our body parts to do certain things. These changes typically happen in girls quicker and earlier than in boys.
Some changes that happen during puberty occur in both girls and boys. These changes include: growing pubic and underarm hair, a stronger body smell, emotional changes and an increased growth rate.
atoms.sound: ssml: Some changes that happen during puberty occur in both girls and boys. These changes include: growing pubic and underarm hair, a stronger body smell, emotional changes and an increased growth rate.

atoms.a: Are some changes in puberty the same in girls and boys?
Select two of the changes that happen in both girls and boys.

instruction.text: There are also some changes that are specific to only girls or only boys. Fill in the gaps.

atoms.b:
Girls begin their menstrual ((++cycle)). This means that their ovaries release egg cells and, if the egg is not fertilised, it is passed out of the vagina as ((++blood)). This is commonly called a period. Girls also grow ((++breasts)), and their hips get wider.

Boys go through ((++other)) changes. Their voices break — which means they get deeper — and they grow ((++facial)) hair. Their penis and testes also grow, and sperm cells start being ((++produced)).

instruction.text: Select the changes that only girls go through during puberty.
